labels.text: Hi! I’m the world’s most annoying salesperson. Do you want to buy Shottr?
1. Go to System Settings → Keyboard → Keyboard Shortcuts
2. Select "Screenshots" and uncheck checkboxes for system shortcuts
3. Put ⌘⇧3 into Fullscreen and ⌘⇧4 into Area fields below

We DO collect: performance metrics, error codes, frequency of feature usage; OS version, screen resolution and internationalization preferences.
We DON'T collect: any personal information, IP address, any images or text. Screenshots never leave the computer unless you upload them to the cloud.
Presigned URLs are only valid for up to 7 days
Will only work if your bucket is public
To upload images to Shottr Cloud, you need a security token. Think of it as a secret code that grants access to your uploads.
Shottr allows you to upload an image online and generate a shareable link. Use the dropdown above to enable this functionality.
